rationale: IMP-DEC-FND002-019. Document 16 section 3.9: 'Domain records store a pinned RightsDecisionRef for the exact action, use basis, and decision time.' The action/use-basis specificity belongs to the resolution receipt that carries this ref beside requested_action and requested_use_basis, not to the ref, so the ref itself is the plain ten-member pin with its schema_ref fixed. A tenant-scoped instance, so the released scope conditional is exercised in its populated direction here and in its forbidding direction by typed-ref-rights-decision-global-with-a-resource-tenant.
